Torvald stuns an enemy with his shield.

Kaya marks a target with ice: damage and a slow.
Озверевшая стая Сумрачного леса. Кусает: A feral pack out of the Gloomwood. It bites fast, but the hide is thin.

Vulnerable to fire. Igni deals double damage.

Хозяин арены Колонии и голос культа Оско: Master of the Colony’s arena and voice of the Shard cult. He claims to hear the Core through the barrier. The names of former champions hang from his chains.
Цеп-слэм читается по кругу-телеграфу. На: The chain slam is telegraphed by a circle on the ground. At 60% health he calls scorpions — save your AoE.

Гора белой шерсти и мышц. Регенерирует н: A mountain of white fur and muscle. It regenerates before your eyes unless you finish it. It guards the Word Walls as if it understood their worth.
Морозный зверь боится огня — Игни наноси: A frost beast that fears fire — Igni deals double damage and hampers its regeneration.
Крылатая тень Стылого Пределья. Говорит: The winged shadow of the Bleak Marches. It speaks a tongue of the ancients, and the snow ignites at its words. Its soul is a womb of Words of Power.
На земле уязвим как зверь; в воздухе дос: On the ground it is vulnerable like any beast; in the air only signs, the bow of Kaya, and shouts reach it. Read the firebombs by the circles on the snow.
Бывший путник: мор добрался до нутра и п: Once a traveler, until the blight reached the innards and remade them. It runs faster than a man and feels no pain. The skin is a crimson crust.

Медлителен. Огонь (Игни) выжигает сросшу: Slow. Fire (Igni) burns away the fused flesh, and Aard brings it crashing down.
Матка Мары: из её брющного мешка выходят: The broodmother of the Blight: ghouls crawl out of her belly-sac, her spittle swarms with corruption. She storms the bastion with the last wave, when the palisade is already trembling.

Дезертир Гранитной Колонии, присягнувший: A deserter of the Granite Colony who swore himself to the Ash Horde. The skin is etched with charcoal patterns, the eyes gleam with delight at another’s grief.
Ashen flesh burns — Igni hits twice as hard. Aard breaks the raid.
Колдун Орды: пепельный гекс летит из-под: A warlock of the Horde: an ashen hex flies from beneath the hood. He shrieks of the "ash judgment" while other homes burn behind him.
Хрупок и труслив — держится в тылу. Игни: Fragile and cowardly — it keeps to the rear. Igni burns out the hex-weave.
Вожак Пепельной Орды. Говорит, что Разло: Chief of the Ash Horde. He says the Rift whispers to him of a "great feast." His shoulder charge hits like a battering ram, and his roar sows panic.
Рывок читается по полосе на земле. Рёв —: The charge is telegraphed by a stripe on the ground. The roar is a cone: sidestep it. Axii holds him for a long while.

Слаб к Аксию (GDD 07 §3): знак разума га: Weak to Axii (GDD 07 §3): the sign of mind snuffs the echo out for a long time. The salvo is a line, the EMP a circle: read the telegraphs; reinforcement drones deploy as her hull wears down.
